amendments.provision: Section 7.11; maximum First Lien Net Leverage Ratio test for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2025
amendments.prior_term: The maximum permitted ratio was 5.00 to 1.00. The Borrower reported a ratio of 5.38 to 1.00 for the quarter.
amendments.amended_term: The Required Lenders waive an Event of Default arising solely from failure of this test for the quarter ended December 31, 2025. No other Default or Event of Default is waived.
amendments.applicability: Applies only to the Borrower's Section 7.11 test for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2025.
amendments.effective_condition: The Amendment must become effective upon receipt of the required executed counterparts, the specified officer's certificate, the separately agreed amendment fee, and reimbursement of the Administrative Agent's invoiced reasonable out-of-pocket expenses.

amendments.provision: Section 7.11; maximum First Lien Net Leverage Ratio for the fiscal quarters ending March 31 and June 30, 2026
amendments.prior_term: The otherwise applicable Section 7.11 maximum ratio governed each quarterly test; the document identifies 5.00 to 1.00 as the limit in effect for the December 31, 2025 test.
amendments.amended_term: The maximum ratio is 5.75 to 1.00 for the quarter ending March 31, 2026 and 5.50 to 1.00 for the quarter ending June 30, 2026. The otherwise applicable limit resumes for the quarter ending September 30, 2026 and thereafter.
amendments.applicability: Applies to the Borrower's specified quarterly tests; all other calculation and testing mechanics remain unchanged.
amendments.effective_condition: The temporary levels take effect only when the Amendment's effectiveness requirements are satisfied.

lender_impact: The Required Lenders consent to a one-quarter historical waiver and temporarily looser leverage thresholds, reducing covenant protection during the specified periods. The relief is limited to the identified test and does not waive other defaults. The document does not state any change to lender commitments, collateral, or payment priority.
borrower_impact: The Borrower receives narrowly defined relief from the December 2025 test and additional leverage capacity for two subsequent quarters. It must satisfy the stated closing deliveries and payments and should plan for the ordinary covenant limit to resume for the September 2026 test. The waiver does not excuse compliance with other covenants or defaults.
financing_impact: The waiver prevents the specified December 2025 leverage-covenant failure from constituting an Event of Default, and the higher temporary thresholds provide additional covenant headroom for the March and June 2026 tests. The ordinary covenant limit resumes in September 2026. The document does not change pricing, maturity, amortization, commitments, or collateral terms.
executive_summary: The Required Lenders waive the leverage-covenant breach for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 and provide higher maximum leverage thresholds for the next two quarterly tests. The ordinary Section 7.11 limit resumes for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The relief is confined to the specified covenant and periods; other defaults and loan terms are not waived or amended.
interpretive_notes: The underlying Credit Agreement is not included. The ordinary leverage threshold after June 30, 2026 is therefore not stated here; the document only provides that the otherwise applicable Section 7.11 limit resumes beginning with the September 30, 2026 test. The separately agreed amendment fee amount and allocation are also not specified.
source_document_text: AMENDMENT NO. 2 AND LIMITED COVENANT WAIVER dated March 10, 2026 (this Amendment), among Alder Ridge Components, Inc., as Borrower, the Guarantors party hereto, the Lenders party hereto, and Northbank Agency Services, as Administrative Agent. Capitalized terms not defined herein have the meanings assigned in the Credit Agreement dated June 18, 2023. 1. Limited waiver. The Required Lenders waive any Event of Default arising solely from the Borrower's failure to satisfy the maximum First Lien Net Leverage Ratio in Section 7.11 for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2025. The Borrower has reported a ratio of 5.38 to 1.00 for that quarter against the 5.00 to 1.00 limit then in effect. This waiver is limited to that test and quarter and does not waive any other Default or Event of Default, whether existing or later arising. 2. Temporary covenant levels. Notwithstanding Section 7.11, the maximum First Lien Net Leverage Ratio shall be 5.75 to 1.00 for the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 2026, and 5.50 to 1.00 for the fiscal quarter ending June 30, 2026. The maximum ratio otherwise applicable under Section 7.11 shall apply beginning with the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2026 and thereafter. All other components of the calculation and testing mechanics in Section 7.11 remain unchanged. 3. Effectiveness. This Amendment becomes effective when the Administrative Agent has received counterparts executed by the Borrower, each Guarantor, and Lenders constituting the Required Lenders; an officer's certificate confirming that the representations in the Credit Agreement are true in all material respects as of the effective date, subject to stated materiality qualifiers and the exception for the waived failure; payment of the amendment fee separately agreed in writing with consenting Lenders; and reimbursement of invoiced, reasonable out-of-pocket fees and expenses of the Administrative Agent. 4. Limited effect; governing terms. Except as expressly amended or waived hereby, the Credit Agreement and other Loan Documents remain in full force and effect. This Amendment is a Loan Document and is governed by the governing-law and jurisdiction provisions of the Credit Agreement.
effectiveness_conditions: Counterparts executed by the Borrower, each Guarantor, and Lenders constituting the Required Lenders must be delivered to the Administrative Agent.
The Administrative Agent must receive an officer's certificate confirming the specified representations, subject to their qualifiers and the stated exception for the waived failure.
The separately agreed amendment fee payable to consenting Lenders must be paid.
Invoiced, reasonable out-of-pocket fees and expenses of the Administrative Agent must be reimbursed.
